basics.name: Satish Upadhyay
basics.title: AI-Driven Product, Services & Business Consultant | Building AI-Enabled SaaS Solutions | Program Manager | CSM® | CSPO®
basics.summary: With over 11+ years of proven success in the software industry, I am an accomplished Program Manager, Business Consultant, Certified Scrum Master® (CSM®), and Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), specializing in agile delivery, AI/ML initiatives, premium business consultation, capacity building, and company expansion into global markets. I have successfully led impactful initiatives, including serving Fortune 500 companies like HP, delivering ODM and customer-facing products, and shaping organizational roadmaps. My expertise in solution architecture, strategic business transformation, project management, and mentorship has made me a key driver of innovation and business growth. As a Product Manager, I am building a SaaS-based CRM application using cutting-edge technology and AI, driving the product from ideation to market launch. My major contributions at BoldTek include Solution designing and Architecture, professional consultation, talent acquisition, capacity building, offshore delivery management, and supporting company expansion across India, the USA, and Taiwan. I excel at defining deliverables, shaping project scopes, and aligning resources for complex initiatives while ensuring seamless collaboration between cross-functional teams and external vendors. By fostering strong networks of project managers and mentoring teams, I have built a culture of accountability and continuous improvement within my organizations. Let’s connect to explore opportunities for driving innovation, offering business consultation, scaling businesses, and delivering cutting-edge technology solutions globally.
